patch_description: This redesign uses a centralized `Game` controller with explicit turn phases: observation update, reservation-aware planning, command emission, and local state application. It replaces scattered global helpers with compact grid masks, one BFS traversal per human, and direct first-step reconstruction. The planner keeps the successful horizontal-strip enclosure concept while improving coordination through same-turn wall reservations, precomputed pet-danger cells, and removal of unnecessary human movement collision restrictions (humans may legally share cells).
